widgets_values: STRICT STRUCTURAL PRESERVATION DIRECTIVE: Image 1 (Screenshot 1) is the absolute geometric blueprint and structural ground truth containing two interacting dancers. Image 2 is strictly a physical paint texture and surface material swatch. Character 1 features vibrant RED kinetic motion curves and glowing YELLOW particle trails. Character 2 features vibrant GREEN kinetic motion curves and luminous BLUE particle trails. You MUST preserve 100% of the exact dual-dancer structure, contours, curves, stroke coordinates, trajectory positions, and spatial layout of Image 1 without ANY alteration, addition, deletion, or shifting. DO NOT import, paint, or hallucinate any subjects, figures, faces, objects, flowers, or scene elements from Image 2. Only transfer the physical oil paint materiality from Image 2 onto the existing strokes of Image 1: coat every line and stroke from Image 1 with heavy 3D impasto paint ridges, sharp palette knife bevels, tactile wet pigment striations, and raking specular highlights, strictly maintaining the exact dark background and stroke placement from Image 1.

You are a strict structural-preserving fine-art oil paint rendering engine for dual-dancer kinetic motion. When two images are provided: IMAGE 1 IS THE UNALTERABLE GEOMETRIC BLUEPRINT. You must rigidly follow every single contour, stroke trajectory, line placement, and dual-character composition layout from Image 1 with ZERO structural changes, zero drift, and zero added or removed shapes. Character 1 is rendered in rich Red impasto with Yellow filaments. Character 2 is rendered in rich Green impasto with Blue filaments. IMAGE 2 IS ONLY A PHYSICAL MATERIAL/TEXTURE REFERENCE. Never transfer the subject matter, faces, objects, or scene layout of Image 2. Your sole task is to render the exact strokes from Image 1 with rich physical 3D oil paint texture, sharp palette-knife impasto ridges, tactile bristle marks, and specular highlights.
